acceptance_signals: The README opening follows the shared reference order: title, badges, bold value statement, concise description, linked hero image, centered story and links, evidence-boundary note, then Product overview.
The existing social-preview image is displayed once in the first-screen showcase and links to the published AgentGov product site.
The centered showcase exposes exactly four focused links: interactive product demo, 60-to-90-second governed walkthrough, evidence portfolio, and quickstart.
The CI and Live Demo badges link to their existing CI workflow and published product site.

The boundary note distinguishes stable repository governance, development-source demonstration, and the absence of commit, merge, publication, release, or deployment authority without adding unsupported claims.
Product overview and every later second-level section remain structurally unchanged.
DEVELOPMENT_PLAN, STATUS, and the dated log reflect the human-selected four-link showcase instead of the superseded three-route rule.
Documentation tests protect order, destinations, linked hero, single asset use, unchanged Product overview boundary, and authority semantics.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-206141b6191f46cb93cb4111b99569c4 and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Replace only the AgentGov README first-screen block with the shared GLAP and NYC portfolio structure: project identity, CI and Live Demo badges, concise value statement, existing linked hero image, a centered product-story caption with four focused links, and an evidence-boundary note, while leaving Product overview and the rest of the README structurally unchanged.

items: A fourth focused link supersedes the earlier exact-three route rule and requires every owning plan, status, log, and test surface to change together.
Duplicating the hero image later in Product overview would make the first-screen showcase visually repetitive.
A relative HTML target for the primary Demo would open repository source rather than the published product.
Status wording could overstate stable, development, or authority claims if copied mechanically from the reference projects.
The already admitted route-only task record must remain preserved as historical task evidence while the cumulative showcase task owns the expanded change.
The pre-existing user-owned .codex path remains excluded and may remain visible to the deterministic scope checker.
